status: expected mechanics from supplied rulebook and English card text, not executed Twinleaf tests
rules: Advanced Player's Rulebook A-02, A-03, B-01, B-02, B-03, II-A, C-14, C-19

cases.given: Budew's Itchy Pollen attack resolved on the prior turn against Player B. No other locks are active.

attempts.action: attach Pokémon Tool from hand (Forest Seal Stone)
attempts.expected: permitted if normal Tool rules satisfied

cases.rationale: Itchy Pollen forbids Item play from hand on the opponent's next turn. Advanced Rulebook B-02 says Pokémon Tools, including older Item-marked printings, are separate from Items.

cases.given: The turn on which Player B was restricted by a previous Itchy Pollen has ended. Budew did not use another Itchy Pollen.

attempts.action: play Item on a later turn
attempts.expected: permitted if no other effect prevents it

cases.rationale: The attack restriction applies during the next opponent turn only, not indefinitely.

cases.given: Player A has Vileplume AOR in play with Irritating Pollen enabled. No other locks are active.
cases.rationale: Irritating Pollen applies to both players and affects Items specifically.

cases.given: Player A has Vileplume AOR with Irritating Pollen. Player B has Garbodor LTR with a Pokémon Tool attached, so Garbotoxin is enabled. No attack-based Item lock is active.
cases.rationale: Garbotoxin suppresses the Item-locking Ability. This case must account for priority and simultaneous effects.

cases.given: Same board as GAR-01, except Garbodor's Pokémon Tool is removed and no other Ability suppression applies.
cases.rationale: Without the attached Tool, Garbotoxin's condition is unsatisfied and Vileplume's persistent Ability resumes.

cases.given: Player A's Iron Thorns ex is Active with Initialization. Player B has Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX in play and attempts to activate Underworld Door; otherwise legal prerequisites are satisfied.
cases.rationale: Iron Thorns ex suppresses Abilities on Rule Box Pokémon in play except Future Pokémon.

cases.given: Player A moves Iron Thorns ex to the Bench. No other Ability suppression is active; Player B has enough Psychic Energy and a legal Benched target.
cases.rationale: Initialization works only while Iron Thorns ex occupies the Active Spot.

cases.given: Player A's Stoutland is Active with Sentinel enabled. No other prohibitions are active.
cases.rationale: Sentinel denies Supporters to the opposing player only while Stoutland is Active.

cases.given: Player A's Vileplume BUS is Active with Disgusting Pollen enabled. Player B's Active is a Basic Pokémon with otherwise sufficient Energy.
cases.rationale: The Basic attack restriction depends on the defender's Stage and Vileplume's Active position.

cases.given: Player A's Snorlax is Active with Block enabled. Player B's Active is a Basic Pokémon given no Retreat Cost by Skyliner; Player B has a Benched Pokémon.

attempts.action: play Switch Item to switch Active with Bench
attempts.expected: permitted if normal Item rules satisfied

cases.rationale: An explicit prohibition on retreat persists even when the Retreat Cost is zero; switching by card effect is a distinct action.
